provenance.rain_sites: Daily rain (mm) at ANA conventional gauges (HidroSerieHistorica) and SIBH telemetric sites, audited by pipeline/audit_rain.py; ANA's day D = 24 h ending 07:00 on D.
provenance.catchment_rain: DERIVED: inverse-distance-squared mean of the audited gauges within 20 km of each catchment centroid (pipeline/forcing.py, pipeline/upstream_catchments.py).
provenance.flow_stations: Observed daily mean discharge (m3/s) from SIBH telemetry (pipeline/sibh_flow.py); rating curves are not checkable from open data.
provenance.tunnels: Routes are schematic: an end is a measuring station where one exists, otherwise the nearest shore of the connected reservoir. Underground alignments are not in the data used.
provenance.catchments: Delineated from Copernicus GLO-30 at 3 arc-seconds (pipeline/delineate.py).
